answer: Divergent Continuation Audit. Each identity carries a private seed and must extend a shared thread with a seed-derived nonce; valid continuations must branch uniquely. Clones forced to reuse a seed produce identical continuations, which auditors flag as collision. Honest agents keep a basalt ledger of branch points, and any duplicate path triggers a lantern challenge requiring fresh unique entropy per identity. Attacker cost: one independently seeded keypair plus ongoing unique proof computation per clone.
